title: PolyTermsShiftRow
html:
定义组：System F 双绑定替换与规约。有序参数：z1967、z1968、z1969。

只提升对应种类的自由指标；两种绑定深度分开。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ PolyTermsShiftRow z1967 z1968 z1969) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

          (and
            (@ Nat c)

              (@ Nat k)
              (and
                (@ PolyAny t)
                (and
                  (@ PolyAny u)
                  (or
                    (exists z1974
                      (and
                        (@ TVar z1974 t)
                        (or
                          (and (in z1974 c) (= t u))
                          (exists z1975 (and (or (= z1974 c) (in c z1974)) (and (@ Add z1974 k z1975) (@ TVar z1975 u)))))))
                    (or
                      (exists z1976

                      (or
                        (exists z1980

                            (and
                            (@ TApp z1980 z1981 t)

                            (exists z1993

                            (and
                            (in z1993 z1968)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1967 z1993 z1994)
                            (exists z1995
                            (and (exists z1996 (and (@ Pair z1981 z1983 z1996) (@ Pair k z1996 z1995))) (@ Pair c z1995 z1994))))))))))))))
                        (or
                          (exists z1978
                            (exists z1979
                            (exists z1984
                            (and
                            (@ FTAbs z1978 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FTAbs z1979 u)
                            (and
                            (= z1984 c)
                            (exists z1997
                            (exists z1998
                            (and
                            (in z1997 z1968)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1967 z1997 z1998)
                            (exists z1999
                            (and (exists z2000 (and (@ Pair z1978 z1979 z2000) (@ Pair k z2000 z1999))) (@ Pair z1984 z1999 z1998)))))))))))))
                          (exists z1980
                            (exists z1982
                            (exists z1976
                            (exists z1977
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z1980 z1976 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z1982 z1977 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z2001
                            (exists z2002
                            (and
                            (in z2001 z1968)

                            (@ App z1967 z2001 z2002)
                            (exists z2003
                            (and (exists z2004 (and (@ Pair z1980 z1982 z2004) (@ Pair k z2004 z2003))) (@ Pair c z2003 z2002)))))))
                            (= z1976 z1977)))))))))))))))))))))
